resources.string: The lock profile stays as you set it
The profile changes by itself when the network changes
When you connect to a network below, its lock profile becomes active without asking for your credential. On any other network, the default profile takes over.

Anyone who can copy your Wi-Fi name and password can trigger a profile switch, so only link networks you trust, and don\'t link a network to a profile that locks fewer apps than you are comfortable with there.
Used on mobile data, with no connection, and on any network without its own profile
Open network: it can\'t be linked to a profile, because anyone can create a network with the same name
Choose the profile to use on this network
No networks linked yet. Connect to a Wi-Fi network and link it to a profile.
This profile was deleted, so the default profile is used instead. Pick another one.

The profile changes a few seconds after the network does, and only once per network: if you switch profile yourself, it stays until the network changes. When the network name can\'t be read, nothing changes. Only networks with a password can be linked.
Profiles also switch by network (Trusted networks)
